messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — my primary got extended on the customer call. I need someone to pick up EU night coverage tonight (23:00-03:00 UTC). I can cover 21:00-23:00 then I'm offline for the holiday. Pager might spike — we have a scheduled model rollout in eu-west that could rattle things.

OncallBot: :bell: Incident alert: 17 new pages in the last hour for region=eu-west. Check /incidents if you are taking this shift.

Ben: I can shadow 23:00-01:00 if needed. I'm traveling but should have phone. Prefer to avoid full primary.

Lucas: I can take full 23:00-03:00 primary if Ben can shadow 23-01. I have laptop + vpn. Not ideal if a hardware swap is required, but ok for software incidents.

Maya: Lucas that would be amazing — thanks. Ben can you confirm the 23-01 shadow? Also Sarah can be secondary/backup?

Ben: Confirmed 23:00-01:00 shadow. I'll be on mobile. Pls paste runbook pointers and the on-call handoff snippet.

Sarah: I can be secondary for 23-03 and take postmortem follow-ups tomorrow. If you take primary Lucas, I'll be reachable for escalations.

RunbookBot: Runbook: EU Inference Surge — https://runbooks.internal/redwood/eu-inference-surge
Steps summary:
1) Check router health dashboard /dashboards/serving-router-eu
2) Confirm model variant fallback status: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/eu/models/status`
3) If error >10% start canary rollback: `kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=<prev>`
4) If SLO breach -> page infra-team and open bridge: /open-bridge

Lucas: Got the runbook. A couple of notes from last time: cache warmers sometimes spike the KV store and cause high 500 rate for ~2m. If you see many 502/504 from cache nodes, try `curl -XPOST https://admin.euw1/cache/reload -H 'X-Runbook: true'` (auth required). I left this command in infra notes.

Maya: Also FYI — customer impact map in the dashboard shows degraded inference for a handful of high-traffic tenants (analytics pipeline). If we get more than 3 distinct tenants with >10% errors escalate to Sales Ops and open a customer-impact thread.

Ben: Noted. Who's on-call infra for EU tonight? I want the direct pager in case we need node reboots.

RotationBot: On-call infra: @haris (infra-eu) is on duty until 02:00 UTC; then @megan takes over. Pager IDs: haris#442, megan#117.

Ben: OK I'll page haris directly if we hit persistent 5xx > 15% for 5m.

Lucas: Handoff checklist for whoever is primary: quick bullets
- Confirm you can access VPC and KMS (ssh/vpn, KMS creds)
- Open bridge on any P1 and post status updates every 10m
- If you roll back, announce models/api route fallback in #platform-announcements
- Keep runbook open and log commands in the bridge notes

Maya: I'll post a quick handoff note in #eng-oncall at 22:50 UTC with the confirmed primary/secondary and contact list. Please add reaction :eyes: once you see it.

Lucas: One more — if you need to escalate to support-engineering for a customer-impact communication, template is here:
```
We're experiencing degraded inference for tenant XYZ in eu-west. Engineering is investigating; estimated mitigation ETA 30-45m. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause.
```
Use that verbatim for consistency.

Sarah: Copy the template. I'll prepare the postmortem skeleton and capture the alert thresholds we used.

Maya: Thanks team. Current plan: Maya 21:00-23:00, Lucas primary 23:00-03:00, Ben shadow 23:00-01:00, Sarah secondary 23:00-03:00. Haris infra contact until 02:00, Megan after. I'll update the rotation bot and send the bridge link at handoff. :+1:

OncallBot: Handoff noted. Created bridge: https://bridges.internal/3072104567-eu-night. Tags: holiday, surge, manual-handoff.

Lucas: I'll be on the bridge at 22:55 to sync with Maya. See you there.

Ben: Ping me if anything unstable before 01:00 and I'll jump in. Have a good holiday everyone. :raised_hands:

Maya: Thanks all — appreciate it. Posting final confirmation now.
